Letmoro — step access

Letmoro reads daily step totals from Health Connect for movement and, when enabled, accounting for completed days. Only step reading is requested. Optional physical activity access enables faster feedback while the app is open.

Daily totals, checkpoints and travel credits are kept with your progress to prevent double counting. If account backup is enabled, this saved progress also synchronizes to your own account. Passwords and session tokens are not part of a game save.

Daily life accounting uses completed days after a 24-hour synchronization margin, in the run’s fixed time zone. The incomplete first day is protected. Missing data is never zero; late corrections recalculate lives.

You can revoke access in Health Connect at any time.
